name: ANDERN - Update By HR7
teaser: Make PMC bots dangerous again! PMC Bots use only weapon from handmade presets, best ammo and gear according to their level.
description_html:
Make PMC bots dangerous again! PMC Bots use only weapon from handmade presets, best ammo and gear according to their level.

This is an updated version of Barlog_M ANDERN MOD. Released under the same license and adding Barlog_M as an additional author.

I will remove this when Barlog_M comes back and has time to update his mods. But for now enjoy. Please give the credit to Barlog

Please read the original mod page for directions, I’ve made no changes to the original mod, only updated and confirmed its working with the current SPT version.

Thanks to Dirtbikercj for indirectly inspiring me without him knowing to update this mod while waiting for the return of the creator of andern

Installation

  • Put folder BarlogM Custom by HR7-Andern from zip file into your <strong>user/mods</strong> folder
  • For more details click on the link above for the detailed description of the mod

Known issues

  • Mod does not work with Algorithmic Level Progression , APBS and Realism

Please give me your feedback if you have any problems with the mod in the #mods-development channel => Threads => ANDERN
